title: Script table array occupancy histogram
summary: Recovered the ECX/EDX fastcall table helper at 0x4f03e0. Reads the array pointer at +12 and signed size at +28, counts nonzero slot tags in one-based power-of-two ranges, adds to up to 27 histogram bins and returns the occupied total. Other table words remain opaque. Direct original disassembly and caller at 0x4f084d establish the register inputs and additive histogram usage.
test_description: Differential GCC i386 fastcall calls against the accepted original at its original VA. Negative/zero sizes, null pointers for empty input, power-of-two boundaries through 65537, empty/full/high-bit/mixed tags, payload independence, prefilled histogram wraparound, surrounding sentinels, all table bytes and array contents checked. Independent expected totals and bins checked too.
known_limits: Partial table layout only; unknown fields and payload interpretation are not recovered.
The 27-bin cap is retained from instructions; arrays reaching 2^26 entries and beyond are not allocated in tests.
Invalid pointers, concurrent mutation and overlapping table/array/histogram storage are outside the controlled tests.
No byte-identical compiler output or full-game equivalence is claimed.
